# testing

Utilities for Manim tests using [pytest](https://pytest.org).

For more information about Manim testing, see:

- [Manim Development Process](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/contributing/development.html), specifically the `Tests` bullet
  point under [Polishing Changes and Submitting a Pull Request](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/contributing/development.html#polishing-changes-and-submitting-a-pull-request)
- [Adding Tests](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/contributing/testing.html)
